atlas_lower_bounds.conditional_owner_policy: The nominated candidate requires a distinct minimum 64x64 owner rectangle for each disk chart. This is not a globally minimal UV padding theorem.
atlas_lower_bounds.surface_area_floor_interpretation: Existing surface area times 4096 squared; a floor, not measured occupied texels.
atlas_lower_bounds.padding_waste_note: Do not subtract the surface-area floor from the owner-area floor and describe the difference as measured padding waste.
atlas_lower_bounds.interpretation: Four atlases are an arithmetic lower bound for these candidate charts and policies. An actual layout may require more, or fail distortion or overlap checks.

gpu_storage_model_both_RGBA8.interpretation: Assumed uncompressed GPU pixel storage when both textures use RGBA8; not a measured allocation or universal device format guarantee.

four_atlas_storage.alpha: Optional alpha is embedded in the already-budgeted base-color RGBA8 texture; no separate alpha texture is counted.
excluded_costs: Mesh, UV, vertex-colour and index buffers
Driver allocation alignment, staging buffers, duplicate CPU copies and loading transients
Encoded image file sizes or measured download size
four_atlas_storage.compression: Conventional texture compression could reduce appropriate runtime or delivery costs; no codec, quality, compression ratio or compressed size has been tested here.

material_and_submission_model.interpretation: This conventional one-material-per-atlas-group model implies at least four material groups and four primitives for four atlases. It is not a universal engine draw-call lower bound; batching, arrays, shader indirection, passes and renderer behavior can change submissions.

export_decision_scope.high_fidelity_option: Multiple atlases are a possible optional high-fidelity route, pending actual UV distortion, overlap, packing, mip-owner and material qualification.
export_decision_scope.game_ready_default: The 4531-face patch is already small. This patch-only cost estimate does not make the roughly four-million-face full source a game-ready default; whole-asset geometry, material and texture budgets need separate qualification.
